added.title: Alien Landscape With
added.prompt:
A color-xerox-looking psychedelic collage depicting an alien, dreamlike landscape composed of black and white and other optical illusion patterns, surreal organic, eye-like lifeforms and biomorphic structures, layered and arranged as if cut, assembled, and recomposed from multiple surreal realities. The scene feels like a collaged ecosystem built from perception itself — eyes embedded in plants, eyes floating independently, eyes growing on stalks, cones, mushrooms, and soft sculptural forms. Some eyes are realistic and detailed, others simplified, graphic, striped, or abstracted.
A slim Caucasian female with long wild thick curly hot pink I hair wonders through with a confused and worried facial expression. Her avant garde clothing features all over black and white optical illusion patterns.
The terrain is smooth and velvety, with optical-illusion patterns — concentric rings, ripples, spirals, and flowing stripes — collaged into the ground and background, subtly disrupting depth and orientation. Elements overlap unnaturally, with intentional scale mismatches and layered planes that flatten and re-expand space.

Color palette is highly saturated, candy-acid, and psychedelic: dominant hot pinks and magentas, with purples, lilacs, teals, cyan, electric blue, and stark black-and-white contrast patterns. Surfaces appear soft, plush, and matte with a faint internal glow. Lighting is even and surreal, minimizing realistic shadows and emphasizing color and form.

The mood is whimsical, hypnotic, and mildly uncanny — playful cosmic strangeness rather than horror. The collage composition creates visual rhythm through repetition of shapes, eyes, and patterns, with no single focal point, encouraging the viewer’s gaze to wander and become lost.

Overall style is psychedelic surrealism, alien botanical collage, dream-logic sci-fi, blending cute and unsettling. No clear narrative or characters — just the sensation of being totally lost inside a psychedelic collage world where vision, pattern, and landscape have fused.

added.prompt:
An avant-garde contemporary art exhibition space themed around the reference image.
The entire exhibition hall (20.0 m x 20.0 m x 8.0 m) integrates architecture, lighting, flooring, walls, 
and ceiling into the artistic expression.

At the far end of the hall stands a massive wall 20 meters wide and 8 meters high.
In the center of this wall, the theme from the reference image is presented in a monumental artistic form.
The image is vivid and three-dimensional, rising toward the viewer, becoming the focal point of the entire space.

A system-generated exhibition title plaque is installed below the central wall.
The title must be abstract, symbolic, and poetic, and must reflect a contemporary artwork.
No price display is provided.

The floor is polished granite with a reflectance of 0.35–0.40.
Patterns and light derived from the reference image cascade across the surface of the work,
resonating with the entire space as if responding to the footsteps of visitors.
Tactile paving bricks are in a similar color, seamlessly integrated, but only 5 mm high, providing a clear texture.
The work extends in a straight line from the entrance to the wall, creating a pause point before the artwork.
After viewing, visitors are naturally guided to an opening on the right side (3 m wide x 3 m high).
In emergencies, floor-level emergency lighting ensures illumination of 1 lux.

The left and right walls and the ceiling each reinterpret an abstract element from the reference image,
transforming the entire space into a single artwork.
The flow of color, form, and light unifies the experience into an artistic whole.

Visitor capacity is limited to 8–25 people.
All visitors face the large wall, moving in a straight line and pausing at the designated point.
No one looks back toward the entrance.
Only one staff member is stationed near the right-side entrance beside the wall.
All faces are blurred to ensure anonymity.

The composition is stable, with the central vanishing point always aligned with the center of the wall.
Verticality is within ±0.5°.
Floor reflections are precise, human figures appear natural.
Hands always show five fingers, eyes are symmetrical within a 3% margin.
Fabrics remain flat with no deformation.

Forbidden content: Elements unrelated to the reference image, missing or broken tactile paving,
visitors facing the entrance, logos or watermarks, overcrowding, toy-like gloss, 2D flat projections,
neon glow, teal-orange tones, oversaturation, perspective collapse, mismatched reflections,
anatomical anomalies, extra limbs, distorted faces, excessive outlines, banding, or vignetting.

DoD: The entire venue will be a contemporary artwork centered on the theme of the reference image,
with the innermost structure forming a unified experience.
The tactile paving synchronizes perfectly with the flow of light, creating a clear pause point.
Visitors are immersed in the space itself, and even in reproduction, SSIM will remain stable at 0.95 or above.

added.title: Create Manga Panel
added.prompt:
Using the user-uploaded image as the primary visual reference, generate a cohesive 3×3 image grid (nine panels total).

CORE CONCEPT:
The nine panels together form a short cinematic visual story.
All panels must depict the same character(s), environment, and universe established by the reference image.
Maintain strict consistency in:
- character identity (face, body, hairstyle)
- clothing and accessories
- art style and rendering quality
- color palette and lighting logic

STORY STRUCTURE:
The grid should read naturally from left to right, top to bottom, like film storyboards or a manga page.
Each panel represents a distinct moment, emotion, or action beat.
There should be a clear sense of progression, not repetition.

PANEL DIRECTION (GUIDELINE):

1. Anchor Frame – use the original uploaded image as-is, establishing character, style, and environment.
2. Reframed Presence – same moment as Panel 1 but with a different crop or angle, showing posture or silhouette.
3. Emotional Close-up – focus on face or key detail, highlighting expression or mood.
4. Perspective Shift – side view, back view, or over-the-shoulder, showing subtle narrative progression.
5. Key Moment – central narrative or emotional focal point of the story.
6. Dynamic Action – character movement, interaction, or dynamic pose.
7. Quiet Aftermath – calm moment after the action, reflection, or pause.
8. World Detail – environment, objects, lighting, or atmosphere, may include partial character.
9. Resolution / Open Ending – final emotional state or symbolic conclusion, leaving a lasting impression.

CAMERA & COMPOSITION:
- Vary camera angles (wide, medium, close-up, low-angle, top-down)
- Use cinematic framing and depth of field
- Avoid repeating identical compositions
- Subtle changes in time, motion, or emotion across panels

VISUAL QUALITY:
- High detail, sharp focus
- Cohesive cinematic lighting
- Natural shadows and realistic or stylistically consistent materials
- No text, no subtitles, no speech bubbles
- No visible borders or frames between panels

FINAL OUTPUT:
A clean, evenly spaced 3×3 grid that feels like keyframes from a short film or a manga chapter.
The result should feel intentional, emotional, and story-driven.

added.title: Create Movie Poster
added.prompt:
Analyze the uploaded photo and detect the subject, mood, and atmosphere. 
Automatically classify the photo into a suitable movie genre (romance, action, mystery, horror, etc.). 

Based on the detected genre and mood, generate all the following elements in English: 
- A cinematic movie title (impactful, authentic to the genre). 
- A short tagline or catchphrase (1–2 lines, dramatic or emotional). 
- A credit block at the bottom (with fake names for director, producer, music, etc., styled like real movie posters). 
- A release note such as “COMING SOON” or “In Theaters 2025.” 

Overlay these elements on the image in a movie-poster style layout: 
- Place the title prominently in the center or lower third. 
- Place the tagline above or below the title. 
- Add a credit block at the bottom in small text. 
- Add the release note at the bottom center. 

Finally, add the starring section at the bottom, always formatted as: 
“Starring: ” 

Typography should be bold, dramatic, and genre-appropriate. 
The final result must look like a genuine movie poster ready for theaters, with all elements harmonized to the photo’s mood.

added.title: Fashion Editorial Collage
added.prompt:
Create a colorful Y2K scrapbook–style poster collage with a vibrant, chaotic-yet-balanced aesthetic. The image should feel like an early-2000s magazine scrapbook filled with stickers, cutouts, doodles, and playful graphic elements. The overall style is frameless, highly artistic, visually dense, and extremely engaging.

The same young Y2K-styled woman appears multiple times throughout the collage, wearing the same outfit and hairstyle in every appearance, but shown in different poses and cutout-style compositions. Her identity must remain perfectly consistent across all instances, with full face-lock accuracy and no facial distortion or changes.

The collage includes the following scenes and poses:

A close-up shot where she forms a heart shape with her fingers

A full-body squatting pose, resting her chin on her hand while holding a white Polaroid camera

A mid-shot touching her cheek while blowing pink bubblegum

A mid-shot smiling elegantly while holding a cat

A seated pose with one eye winking and a peace sign gesture

A mid-shot holding a bouquet of daisy flowers

At the center of the composition is the main subject in a confident, playful Y2K pose. She slightly pops one hip to the side, faces the camera directly with a cute-cool expression and a subtle pout, and holds a lens-flare keychain in one hand. The vibe is candid, nostalgic, and unmistakably early 2000s.

Her outfit consists of a cropped oversized pastel sweater decorated with embroidered patches, paired with a pastel skirt and a white belt. She wears white ankle socks with colorful pastel stripes and white sneakers. Accessories include colorful plastic bracelets, chunky bright rings, and a sparkling belly chain.

Her hairstyle is a classic Y2K half-up, half-down look with wavy dark brown hair. The lower strands are tinted bubblegum pink, with thin front tendrils framing the face and pastel flower clips adding a playful touch.

The collage is packed with additional visual elements such as heart, star, and butterfly stickers, retro sparkles, Polaroid frames, neon outlines, doodle borders, and magazine-style cutout text reading “SO CUTE!”, “199X!”, and “GIRL VIBES”. The lighting is pastel and dreamy, with a glossy retro glow and holographic textures, pastel gradients, glitter accents, and playful doodles layered throughout.

Color grading is bold and cinematic with a neon Y2K palette. Lighting resembles soft on-camera flash. Skin texture appears smooth and glossy, consistent with high-end Y2K editorial imagery. The rendering is high-detail, hyperrealistic within the Y2K aesthetic, in ultra-high resolution, with a perfectly balanced and artistic composition.

Avoid anything that breaks the Y2K style. Do not include modern 2020s fashion, messy layouts, blurred faces, distorted hands, extra limbs, warped facial features, low resolution, heavy grain, muted colors, watermarks, or visible AI artifacts. The final image should feel polished, nostalgic, and authentically Y2K rather than modern or realistic in a contemporary sense.

added.title: Generate 3x3 Image
added.prompt:
Using the user-uploaded image as the primary visual reference, generate a cohesive 3×3 image grid (nine panels total).

CORE CONCEPT:
The nine panels together form a short cinematic visual story.
All panels must depict the same character(s), environment, and universe established by the reference image.
Maintain strict consistency in:
- character identity (face, body, hairstyle)
- clothing and accessories
- art style and rendering quality
- color palette and lighting logic

STORY STRUCTURE:
The grid should read naturally from left to right, top to bottom, like film storyboards or a manga page.
Each panel represents a distinct moment, emotion, or action beat.
There should be a clear sense of progression, not repetition.

PANEL DIRECTION (GUIDELINE):

1. Anchor Frame – use the original uploaded image as-is, establishing character, style, and environment.
2. Reframed Presence – same moment as Panel 1 but with a different crop or angle, showing posture or silhouette.
3. Emotional Close-up – focus on face or key detail, highlighting expression or mood.
4. Perspective Shift – side view, back view, or over-the-shoulder, showing subtle narrative progression.
5. Key Moment – central narrative or emotional focal point of the story.
6. Dynamic Action – character movement, interaction, or dynamic pose.
7. Quiet Aftermath – calm moment after the action, reflection, or pause.
8. World Detail – environment, objects, lighting, or atmosphere, may include partial character.
9. Resolution / Open Ending – final emotional state or symbolic conclusion, leaving a lasting impression.

CAMERA & COMPOSITION:
- Vary camera angles (wide, medium, close-up, low-angle, top-down)
- Use cinematic framing and depth of field
- Avoid repeating identical compositions
- Subtle changes in time, motion, or emotion across panels

VISUAL QUALITY:
- High detail, sharp focus
- Cohesive cinematic lighting
- Natural shadows and realistic or stylistically consistent materials
- No text, no subtitles, no speech bubbles
- No visible borders or frames between panels

FINAL OUTPUT:
A clean, evenly spaced 3×3 grid that feels like keyframes from a short film or a manga chapter.
The result should feel intentional, emotional, and story-driven.

added.title: Generate Portrait Based
added.prompt:
I. Overall Objective

1. Function Description: Based on user-uploaded reference images, extract the subject's temperament, makeup style, lighting, and color characteristics to create a unique fashion portrait collage.

2. Difference Requirements: Preserve the facial features and overall temperament of the reference subject; do not directly copy the original image. Makeup and composition should be creatively varied within the same stylistic framework.

II. Input Reference Image Requirements

1. Reference Content: A clear front-facing or two-thirds profile photo of a person, clearly showing facial features, skin texture, and general lighting atmosphere.

2. Extraction Key Points: Extract skin tone, makeup intensity, main color tone, lighting direction, subject temperament, and clothing color scheme from the reference image.

III. Image Composition and Output Format

1. Main Image: Generate a super close-up or close-up of the subject's face, with the head and shoulders occupying most of the image space. The gaze can be designed with reference to the temperament of the original image.

2. Collage Structure: Add multiple small images to the right side or corner, including close-ups of profiles, hands, and makeup details, creating a magazine-like layout.

3. Background: Keep the background simple and clean, using solid colors or slight brightness transitions to highlight the subject and makeup.

IV. Text and Graphic Design

1. Title Text: Place a large magazine title at the top of the image, with a simple and powerful font, centered or top-center aligned.

2. Subtitles and Small Text: Add several lines of small text to one side or bottom of the image. This can include keywords, names, and dates, arranged neatly with a consistent font size.

3. Geometric Shapes: Add thin lines, narrow rectangular color blocks, or semi-transparent color blocks around the subject, combining them with text to enhance the sense of planar composition.

V. Style Inheritance Rules

1. Color Inheritance: The overall color tone, contrast, and warm/cool tones should closely match the style of the reference image. The main color should come from the most prominent makeup or clothing color in the reference image.

2. Lighting Inheritance: Refer to the original image's lighting direction and softness. If the original image uses soft lighting, maintain the soft lighting texture; if the original image has high contrast, retain a certain degree of sharpness.

3. Makeup Inheritance: Maintain the same style level based on the makeup characteristics of the reference image (clear, intense, experimental, natural, etc.), then make subtle variations in eye makeup, blush, and lip makeup.

4. Atmosphere Inheritance: Continue the emotional atmosphere of the reference image, such as a cool, sweet, rebellious, or mysterious feel, echoing it in expressions and postures.

VI. Creative Variation Rules

1. Makeup Variation: Add localized exaggerations to the reference style, such as expanding the blush area, enhancing lip shading, adding freckles or highlights.

2. Composition Variation: Adjust the facial angle, cropping area, and small image collage position to ensure different compositions for each generation.

3. Accessory Variation: Add simple yet stylish accessories to the neck, ears, or hands, echoing the main color scheme but not completely replicating the reference image. 4. Detailed Gestures: Add hand gestures such as touching the lips, cheeks, and under the eyes to make the image more narrative and engaging.

VII. Overall Texture and Post-Production Style

1. Clarity: Maintain the visibility of skin pores and details, avoid excessive smoothing, but appropriately soften non-focus areas.

2. Tone Processing: Maintain a unified overall tone, moderately reduce distracting colors, and only enhance the main color and a few accent colors.

3. Emotional Expression: Based on the mood of the reference image, control the intensity of facial expressions and eye contact to ensure the image retains its original style while possessing a unique personality.

Referring to user-uploaded portrait photos, the image style is automatically read and created according to the above rules.

added.title: Hybrid Photo Illustration Mixed
added.prompt:
high-quality hybrid photo-illustration of a subject, featuring a clean "mixed-media" aesthetic where a realistic photograph is blended with bold, vector-style hand-drawn graphics.
Core Stylistic Structure:
Realistic Portrait Base: The central subject's face and hair, along with the immediate background, are high-quality and photorealistic. The background is slightly blurred to create depth.
Overlaid Vector Illustration: Specific elements within the frame are replaced or overlaid with clean-lined, vibrantly colored 2D vector illustrations.
Hybrid Accessories: Any items worn on the head or face (e.g., sunglasses, hats, jewelry) are rendered as flat, stylized graphic overlays with sharp outlines.
Hybrid Held Items: Any object held by the subject (e.g., food, drink, or tools) is rendered entirely as a cartoon-style graphic piece, featuring bold outlines, simplified shading, and stylized details like drips or highlights.
Illustrated Clothing: The subject's outfit is depicted as a flat, 2D illustrated graphic layer with vibrant colors, worn over the realistic portrait.
Graphic Enhancements:
VFX Overlays: Dynamic "liquid splashes," "pop-art sparkles," and tiny stars are scattered around the illustrated objects to add energy and movement.
Visual Contrast: A sharp, intentional contrast between the natural skin tones/textures of the photo and the highly saturated, solid colors of the 2D illustrations (vivid reds, electric blues, bright yellows).
Aesthetic & Finish:
A professional and artistic mixed-media composition. The transition between the realistic photo and the graphic drawing is crisp, clean, and seamless, creating a unique "augmented reality" look.

For visual cohesion, costumes and props should remain consistent between the inner and outer figures.

added.title: Photo Into Geometric
added.prompt:
I. Overall Objective

1. Function Description: Based on user-uploaded reference images, extract the subject's temperament, makeup style, lighting, and color characteristics to create a unique fashion portrait collage.

2. Difference Requirements: Preserve the facial features and overall temperament of the reference subject; do not directly copy the original image. Makeup and composition should be creatively varied within the same stylistic framework.

II. Input Reference Image Requirements

1. Reference Content: A clear front-facing or two-thirds profile photo of a person, clearly showing facial features, skin texture, and general lighting atmosphere.

2. Extraction Key Points: Extract skin tone, makeup intensity, main color tone, lighting direction, subject temperament, and clothing color scheme from the reference image.

III. Image Composition and Output Format

1. Main Image: Generate a super close-up or close-up of the subject's face, with the head and shoulders occupying most of the image space. The gaze can be designed with reference to the temperament of the original image.

2. Collage Structure: Add multiple small images to the right side or corner, including close-ups of profiles, hands, and makeup details, creating a magazine-like layout.

3. Background: Keep the background simple and clean, using solid colors or slight brightness transitions to highlight the subject and makeup.

IV. Text and Graphic Design

1. Title Text: Place a large magazine title at the top of the image, with a simple and powerful font, centered or top-center aligned.

2. Subtitles and Small Text: Add several lines of small text to one side or bottom of the image. This can include keywords, names, and dates, arranged neatly with a consistent font size.

3. Geometric Shapes: Add thin lines, narrow rectangular color blocks, or semi-transparent color blocks around the subject, combining them with text to enhance the sense of planar composition.

V. Style Inheritance Rules

1. Color Inheritance: The overall color tone, contrast, and warm/cool tones should closely match the style of the reference image. The main color should come from the most prominent makeup or clothing color in the reference image.

2. Lighting Inheritance: Refer to the original image's lighting direction and softness. If the original image uses soft lighting, maintain the soft lighting texture; if the original image has high contrast, retain a certain degree of sharpness.

3. Makeup Inheritance: Maintain the same style level based on the makeup characteristics of the reference image (clear, intense, experimental, natural, etc.), then make subtle variations in eye makeup, blush, and lip makeup.

4. Atmosphere Inheritance: Continue the emotional atmosphere of the reference image, such as a cool, sweet, rebellious, or mysterious feel, echoing it in expressions and postures.

VI. Creative Variation Rules

1. Makeup Variation: Add localized exaggerations to the reference style, such as expanding the blush area, enhancing lip shading, adding freckles or highlights.

2. Composition Variation: Adjust the facial angle, cropping area, and small image collage position to ensure different compositions for each generation.

3. Accessory Variation: Add simple yet stylish accessories to the neck, ears, or hands, echoing the main color scheme but not completely replicating the reference image. 4. Detailed Gestures: Add hand gestures such as touching the lips, cheeks, and under the eyes to make the image more narrative and engaging.

VII. Overall Texture and Post-Production Style

1. Clarity: Maintain the visibility of skin pores and details, avoid excessive smoothing, but appropriately soften non-focus areas.

2. Tone Processing: Maintain a unified overall tone, moderately reduce distracting colors, and only enhance the main color and a few accent colors.

3. Emotional Expression: Based on the mood of the reference image, control the intensity of facial expressions and eye contact to ensure the image retains its original style while possessing a unique personality.

Referring to user-uploaded portrait photos, the image style is automatically read and created according to the above rules.

added.prompt:
I. Overall Objective

1. Function Description: Based on user-uploaded reference images, extract the subject's temperament, makeup style, lighting, and color characteristics to create a unique fashion portrait collage.

2. Difference Requirements: Preserve the facial features and overall temperament of the reference subject; do not directly copy the original image. Makeup and composition should be creatively varied within the same stylistic framework.

II. Input Reference Image Requirements

1. Reference Content: A clear front-facing or two-thirds profile photo of a person, clearly showing facial features, skin texture, and general lighting atmosphere.

2. Extraction Key Points: Extract skin tone, makeup intensity, main color tone, lighting direction, subject temperament, and clothing color scheme from the reference image.

III. Image Composition and Output Format

1. Main Image: Generate a super close-up or close-up of the subject's face, with the head and shoulders occupying most of the image space. The gaze can be designed with reference to the temperament of the original image.

2. Collage Structure: Add multiple small images to the right side or corner, including close-ups of profiles, hands, and makeup details, creating a magazine-like layout.

3. Background: Keep the background simple and clean, using solid colors or slight brightness transitions to highlight the subject and makeup.

IV. Text and Graphic Design

1. Title Text: Place a large magazine title at the top of the image, with a simple and powerful font, centered or top-center aligned.

2. Subtitles and Small Text: Add several lines of small text to one side or bottom of the image. This can include keywords, names, and dates, arranged neatly with a consistent font size.

3. Geometric Shapes: Add thin lines, narrow rectangular color blocks, or semi-transparent color blocks around the subject, combining them with text to enhance the sense of planar composition.

V. Style Inheritance Rules

1. Color Inheritance: The overall color tone, contrast, and warm/cool tones should closely match the style of the reference image. The main color should come from the most prominent makeup or clothing color in the reference image.

2. Lighting Inheritance: Refer to the original image's lighting direction and softness. If the original image uses soft lighting, maintain the soft lighting texture; if the original image has high contrast, retain a certain degree of sharpness.

3. Makeup Inheritance: Maintain the same style level based on the makeup characteristics of the reference image (clear, intense, experimental, natural, etc.), then make subtle variations in eye makeup, blush, and lip makeup.

4. Atmosphere Inheritance: Continue the emotional atmosphere of the reference image, such as a cool, sweet, rebellious, or mysterious feel, echoing it in expressions and postures.

VI. Creative Variation Rules

1. Makeup Variation: Add localized exaggerations to the reference style, such as expanding the blush area, enhancing lip shading, adding freckles or highlights.

2. Composition Variation: Adjust the facial angle, cropping area, and small image collage position to ensure different compositions for each generation.

3. Accessory Variation: Add simple yet stylish accessories to the neck, ears, or hands, echoing the main color scheme but not completely replicating the reference image. 4. Detailed Gestures: Add hand gestures such as touching the lips, cheeks, and under the eyes to make the image more narrative and engaging.

VII. Overall Texture and Post-Production Style

1. Clarity: Maintain the visibility of skin pores and details, avoid excessive smoothing, but appropriately soften non-focus areas.

2. Tone Processing: Maintain a unified overall tone, moderately reduce distracting colors, and only enhance the main color and a few accent colors.

3. Emotional Expression: Based on the mood of the reference image, control the intensity of facial expressions and eye contact to ensure the image retains its original style while possessing a unique personality.

Referring to user-uploaded portrait photos, the image style is automatically read and created according to the above rules.

You are a movie VFX (visual effects) concept artist. Seamlessly composite a realistic CGI-created "Stand" into the provided live-action photo without any sense of incongruity.

added.title: Street Mural Portrait
added.prompt:
A high-resolution, cinematic street mural on a large urban wall, featuring a close-up, semi-cartoon, semi-realistic portrait of a single person whose identity, facial features, hairstyle, accessories, skin tone, and age are taken exactly from the user’s uploaded reference photo, with the reference image used as the sole source for the main character’s appearance and expression, without altering bone structure or age, and only allowing minor styling tweaks to better integrate the character into the mural scene.
The character’s gender presentation is kept visually neutral, avoiding exaggerated masculine or feminine cues while still remaining fully consistent with the real person in the reference, preserving the same hairline, eye color, facial proportions, and any visible accessories such as glasses, earrings, or headwear, which should be redrawn faithfully unless a tiny adjustment is needed to match the mural composition.
The portrait shows the person from shoulders up, facing slightly toward the viewer with a calm, gentle, serene expression, eyes softly focused, conveying emotional ease and reassurance, with subtle line-work and soft shading that bridge the gap between realistic portraiture and clean cartoon outlines typical of polished contemporary street art.
The upper section of the wall is filled with an expansive field of blooming roses in various shades of soft pink, deep red, cream, and peach, surrounded by lush, saturated green leaves, painted with high-detail textures, layered petals, and subtle highlights that give the flowers a rich, almost tactile depth.
Clusters of roses cascade down the wall in flowing arcs, with some branches visually blending into the character’s hair so that sections of the hair transform seamlessly into layered rose petals and foliage, creating the illusion that the person is emerging from, or partially formed by, the floral composition.
Around the character’s head, the densest roses and leaves form an elegant, organic floral crown, with overlapping blossoms that frame the face and create a romantic, dreamy halo effect, while still keeping the key facial features from the reference photo fully visible and accurate.
A clear, soft blue sky with scattered fluffy white clouds occupies the upper background beyond the mural wall edges, adding airy depth and contrast to the saturated colors of the roses and the portrait, enhancing the serene and hopeful atmosphere.
At street level, the ground is rendered as realistic, slightly worn asphalt with detailed texture, subtle cracks, and reflected light, scattered with colorful fallen rose petals in different stages of fading, as if carried by wind from the mural into the real environment.
A few casually dressed pedestrians walk or stand near the mural, painted small in scale and slightly blurred with soft motion to keep the focus on the portrait, reinforcing the sense that this is a living, urban street scene rather than a studio composition.
The overall lighting is bright yet soft, like an early morning or late afternoon glow, with gentle highlights on the character’s face and roses, and subtle shadows on the wall and asphalt, creating a dreamy, almost hyper-real visual quality typical of high-end photographic street art.
Color grading leans toward warm, inviting tones with balanced contrast: vibrant rose colors, natural skin tones faithful to the reference photo, neutral gray asphalt, and a clean blue sky, all unified by a slightly cinematic, pastel-infused palette that supports a calm, reassuring mood.
On the mural wall, integrated into the composition near the portrait but not covering the character’s face, add the phrase
“ Adi brill ” 
in a bold, legible, street-art graffiti style, with dynamic lettering, layered colors, and soft outlines, harmonizing with the floral palette while standing out clearly as a positive, encouraging message.
The Arabic text should read naturally as part of the artwork: slightly angled, with paint drips, spray textures, and subtle glow or shadow, placed so that some small rose elements weave in front of or behind parts of the letters, tying the message visually to the surrounding flowers and to the theme of emotional ease.
Ensure the phrase’s meaning, “Adi brill ” is reflected in the character’s gentle expression, the light, open sky, and the soft scattering of petals, so that the entire mural communicates emotional simplicity, letting go of stress, and finding calm in the middle of the city’s hard surfaces.
Compositionally, keep the character’s face as the central focal point, framed by the floral crown and guided by leading lines created by cascading roses and street-level perspective lines on the asphalt, with pedestrians and background details deliberately less sharp and less saturated to avoid stealing attention
Use a high-resolution, ultra-detailed rendering style suitable for large-format wall art, with crisp edges, visible brush or spray-paint textures, and fine details 
Final instruction: strictly base the main character’s identity, age, and key features on the single uploaded reference image, maintaining a gender-neutral presentation and avoiding any beautification that changes bone structure or age, while adapting clothing colors, lighting, and minor styling only as needed to harmonize with the dreamy, romantic, rose-filled street mural
Output:
A realistic image that meets the above scene requirements. Please submit it in landscape dimensions, 16:9 aspect ratio, and high quality.

added.prompt:
**Task: Create a comprehensive "Wardrobe Deconstruction and Style Profile" collage based on an uploaded image.**

**Objective:**
Act as a professional fashion archivist and technical designer. Given an uploaded image of a person, generate a visually compelling, high-resolution "Style Profile" collage that meticulously deconstructs their entire ensemble, from the outermost layer to the foundational structure. The final output must be a single, cohesive, photorealistic image.

**Core Elements:**

1.  **Central Subject Image:**
    *   Place the subject from the uploaded image in a full-body pose as the central focus.
    *   Maintain the subject's likeness (face, hair, clothing) while enhancing the image to a professional, high-fashion photographic standard.

2.  **Complete Ensemble Deconstruction (Photorealistic Product Shots):**
    *   Generate a visual breakdown of the subject's attire, presenting each item as a separate, high-quality product photograph. This breakdown must include:
        *   **Outer and Mid-Layers:** All visible garments and accessories.
        *   **Foundational Elements:** A technical illustration of the essential structural garments that provide shape and support to the silhouette (e.g., a bra, slip, or specific underlayer). These elements must be rendered as **objective, flat-lay design schematics** with a focus on material and construction, not on the human form.
    *   Include detailed close-ups of key materials (e.g., fabric weave, leather texture, metal finish) to emphasize quality and design.

3.  **Lifestyle & Contextual Items:**
    *   Based on the subject's style, infer and generate a collection of 4-6 photorealistic items that suggest their likely environment, interests, or daily routine.

4.  **Expression & Detail Sheet:**
    *   Generate a series of 3-4 close-up portraits showing a range of natural, context-appropriate expressions.

**Aesthetic and Layout Guidelines:**

*   **Overall Style:** Strictly **Hyper-realistic, photographic style**. Absolutely no illustration, anime, or hand-drawn elements.
*   **Layout:** Arrange all elements in a **clean, balanced, and modular collage** on a neutral background (white or light gray). The layout must be visually logical and professional, resembling a high-end fashion technical document.
*   **Annotations:** Use a clean, minimalist font for all text.
    *   **Title:** Generate a professional, gender-neutral title (e.g., "Technical Deconstruction: The Urban Minimalist").
    *   **Labels:** Add brief, descriptive labels for all deconstructed items, including the "Foundational Elements," using technical terms (e.g., "Structural Support Garment," "Base Layer").

**Crucial Instruction:** The rendering of all "Foundational Elements" must be purely technical and objective, presented as a **design schematic or flat-lay product shot** to emphasize construction and material, completely detached from the central subject's body.

Create a colorful Y2K scrapbook–style poster collage with a vibrant, chaotic-yet-balanced aesthetic. The image should feel like an early-2000s magazine scrapbook filled with stickers, cutouts, doodles, and playful graphic elements. The overall style is frameless, highly artistic, visually dense, and extremely engaging.

The same young Y2K-styled woman appears multiple times throughout the collage, wearing the same outfit and hairstyle in every appearance, but shown in different poses and cutout-style compositions. Her identity must remain perfectly consistent across all instances, with full face-lock accuracy and no facial distortion or changes.

The collage includes the following scenes and poses:

A close-up shot where she forms a heart shape with her fingers

A full-body squatting pose, resting her chin on her hand while holding a white Polaroid camera

A mid-shot touching her cheek while blowing pink bubblegum

A mid-shot smiling elegantly while holding a cat

A seated pose with one eye winking and a peace sign gesture

A mid-shot holding a bouquet of daisy flowers

At the center of the composition is the main subject in a confident, playful Y2K pose. She slightly pops one hip to the side, faces the camera directly with a cute-cool expression and a subtle pout, and holds a lens-flare keychain in one hand. The vibe is candid, nostalgic, and unmistakably early 2000s.

Her outfit consists of a cropped oversized pastel sweater decorated with embroidered patches, paired with a pastel skirt and a white belt. She wears white ankle socks with colorful pastel stripes and white sneakers. Accessories include colorful plastic bracelets, chunky bright rings, and a sparkling belly chain.

Her hairstyle is a classic Y2K half-up, half-down look with wavy dark brown hair. The lower strands are tinted bubblegum pink, with thin front tendrils framing the face and pastel flower clips adding a playful touch.

The collage is packed with additional visual elements such as heart, star, and butterfly stickers, retro sparkles, Polaroid frames, neon outlines, doodle borders, and magazine-style cutout text reading “SO CUTE!”, “199X!”, and “GIRL VIBES”. The lighting is pastel and dreamy, with a glossy retro glow and holographic textures, pastel gradients, glitter accents, and playful doodles layered throughout.

Color grading is bold and cinematic with a neon Y2K palette. Lighting resembles soft on-camera flash. Skin texture appears smooth and glossy, consistent with high-end Y2K editorial imagery. The rendering is high-detail, hyperrealistic within the Y2K aesthetic, in ultra-high resolution, with a perfectly balanced and artistic composition.

Avoid anything that breaks the Y2K style. Do not include modern 2020s fashion, messy layouts, blurred faces, distorted hands, extra limbs, warped facial features, low resolution, heavy grain, muted colors, watermarks, or visible AI artifacts. The final image should feel polished, nostalgic, and authentically Y2K rather than modern or realistic in a contemporary sense.
